info.title: clrd
info.description: Self-hosted notifications where a dismissal on one device clears it on every device. See docs/SPEC.md.

503.description: A background job (snooze wake, prune) failed 3 times in a row; failing names it. Errors are in the server log.

404.description: Setup is finished (an admin token exists).

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: One-time setup code printed in the server log.

post.summary: Web sign-in: swap a token for a session cookie

200.description: JSON post: the token minted for this browser

303.description: Form post: redirect to next (default /app). A wrong token redirects there too, with error=token added to the query.

post.description: Must be same-origin. Mints a token for this browser with the same scopes and topics and sets it as an HttpOnly cookie.

name.description: Device name for this browser. Default: from the User-Agent.
Device name for this browser. Default: from the User-Agent.

post.description: Scope publish. With status "resolved" it resolves the open row with that external_id instead (404 if none). To upload a file, send multipart/form-data: a part named notification holding the JSON first, then a part named file. Over CLRD_ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB is a 413; over CLRD_ATTACHMENT_TOTAL_MB is a 507. Over the per-token or per-topic publish rate (CLRD_RATE_TOKEN, CLRD_RATE_TOPIC) is a 429 with Retry-After.

epoch.description: This database's id. A different one from the saved one means: treat it like reset.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: open (active, acknowledged, snoozed), all, or one state

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor: id of the last row of the previous page

patch.description: Replaces the message of an open notification in place; its id and state stay. Needs publish scope on the topic. 409 once it is dismissed or resolved.

post.description: Records which reply action was tapped and acknowledges the notification. Needs read scope. 400 if the value is not one of its reply actions; 409 if it is already answered, dismissed or resolved (the first answer wins).

seq.description: The notification seq the device showed. If the notification changed since, 409. Omit or 0 to skip the check.

post.description: Give for (Go duration, d allowed) or until.
Give topic or ids, not both. Every state change also takes an optional via (docs/SPEC.md section 5).

via.description: How the clear was made, recorded on each state event

get.description: Scope read on the notification's topic. png, jpeg, gif and webp are served inline; everything else as a download. 404 once the file is gone.
Scope read. Also sent as a settings message on the WebSocket and SSE streams, just before ready and again after every change.

put.description: Scope read. Only the fields given change; a topic mapped to null in topic_previews drops its override. The four switches need a token with no topic list; a topic override needs that topic. keep_cleared_days needs scope admin.

keep_cleared_days.description: Days dismissed and resolved notifications are kept after they were cleared. 0 keeps them forever. Needs scope admin.

sound.description: The asking device's own notification sound, a name from GET /api/v1/sounds. Needs a token with no topic list.

get.description: Scope read. Fetches /favicon.ico, then the page's icon link, over https. Raster images only. Cached 7 days, failures too. Any failure (blocked address, timeout, not found) returns the same fallback SVG.
Scope read. 403 unless link previews are on (globally or for topic). Reads Open Graph tags; cached 24 hours, failures too. A page that cannot be fetched returns only url.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The notification's topic, so its override applies.

get.description: Runs plain string rules over the newest 500 notifications this token can read and returns the topics with findings: markdown_as_text, unknown_shortcode, no_title, long_body (over 2000 characters) and json_dump. Each finding has a count, the newest example and the fix in plain words; each topic has a prompt to paste into an agent to fix its sender. Advice only: nothing is stored or changed.

findings.fix: Messages have no title. Send a short title...

topics.prompt: Fix the program that sends notifications to the clrd topic "backups"...

get.description: How many notifications this token can read are in each state, plus inbox (active and acknowledged) and cleared (dismissed and resolved). Every key is always present. With keep_cleared_days, also would_remove: how many cleared notifications that setting would delete now.

parameters.name: keep_cleared_days
parameters.description: Preview a keep_cleared_days value before saving it.

put.summary: Set a topic's icon or its expected check-in interval
put.description: Scope publish on the topic. An empty icon removes it; notifications already published keep their icon. A checkin interval makes the topic a dead man's switch: when no message arrives in time the server publishes an urgent notification with external_id clrd-checkin, and the next message resolves it.

icon.description: http(s) image URL, at most 2048 characters, or "" to remove the topic icon.

checkin.description: Expected interval between messages, a Go duration from 1m to 8784h such as "25h", or "" to turn it off. The timer starts when set.

get.summary: Devices seen in the last 10 minutes
get.description: Scope read. A topic-limited token only sees devices limited to its own topics. With all=1, every linked device instead (see the parameter).

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Any value: list every device, not only recent ones, with kind (token, browser or phone), via, linked_at, last_seen_at, this, can_unlink, sound, and the live sync state: connected (has a stream open now), caught_up (one of its streams has finished replay) and synced_seq (the last event seq the server sent it). A full admin sees every token; anyone else sees the devices under the token they signed in with, phones linked from them and browsers those phones approved.

get.description: Scope read. Links, sign-ins and unlinks, newest first, at most 200: {"events":[{"at","action","device","device_id","by"}]}. action is linked, signed in or unlinked; by is the name of the device that did it. A full admin sees every line; anyone else only the lines for their own devices, as in GET /api/v1/devices?all=1.
Scope read. {"sounds":[...],"default":"default"}. default is the device's own system or browser sound and none is silent. Each device's choice is set with PUT /api/v1/devices/{id}.

put.description: Scope read, from a token not limited to some topics. Body {"sound":"chime"}, a name from GET /api/v1/sounds; an unknown name gives 400 listing the valid ones. The caller must see the device in GET /api/v1/devices?all=1 (else 404). Returns the device. The device's settings stream carries the new sound.

200.description: The device, with its new sound

delete.summary: Unlink a browser or phone (signed out at once)
delete.description: Scope read. Signs the device out at once with every browser it approved: open streams close and the next request gets 401. The caller must see the device in GET /api/v1/devices?all=1 (else 404). A typed-in token is revoked with DELETE /api/v1/tokens/{id} instead (403 here).

get.description: Admin with no topic limit.

grants.description: Per-topic rules instead of topics, first match decides (spec section 4). Not with topics or the admin scope; each grant's scopes must be held by the token.

get.description: Admin only. Every CLRD_* environment setting in effect, defaults filled in, written the way the variable takes it (CLRD_BASE_URL is empty when unset; 0 turns a rate limit off). Read only: change one by setting the variable and restarting the server. Holds no secrets.

delete.summary: Revoke a token (open streams close at once)

get.description: Admin only. Counts of ntfy publish headers, query parameters and JSON fields clrd accepted but did not act on, so a service moved from ntfy can be checked. HTML when the request accepts text/html. At most 200 names.

101.description: Upgrade. Frames are Event JSON: replay after since, then {"type":"ready","seq":N}, then live. {"type":"reset"} means the cursor is gone: drop local state and fetch GET /api/v1/notifications?state=open, keeping the connection.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Last seq the client has; replay starts after it. Default 0.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Optional comma list of topics to filter to.

get.description: 410 with code reset when since is older than the log or ahead of the server.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Last seq the client has; replay starts after it. Default 0.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Optional comma list of topics to filter to.

get.description: Who the credentials belong to, as ntfy answers it. No credentials gives the anonymous account; wrong ones give 401.
Scope read. The silences on topics this token may read, and those with no topic. Ended silences are not listed.

post.summary: Silence a topic, a tag, or a tag within a topic
post.description: Scope publish on the topic. A silence with no topic (every topic) needs a token without a topic list. Notifications still arrive and sync; every event written while a silence matches has silenced true, and clients do not alert. Mutes every priority, including 5. Give exactly one of for (a duration like 2h) or until (RFC3339), at most 8784h ahead.

400.description: No topic or tag, or a bad time

403.description: No publish scope on the topic
No publish scope on the topic

404.description: No such active silence on a topic this token can see

get.summary: List the outgoing webhooks on a topic
get.description: Scope admin. Secrets are never returned; has_secret says whether one is set. enabled is false once the server turned a failing hook off.

put.summary: Save an outgoing webhook: POST the topic's state changes to a URL
put.description: Scope admin. Replaces the whole hook and turns it back on. Each delivery's body is the sync stream event; X-Clrd-Event names it and X-Clrd-Signature is sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body> when a secret is set. Private addresses and ports other than 80 and 443 are refused at send time. See docs/integrations/webhooks-out.md.

events.description: Any of dismissed, acknowledged, resolved, snoozed, action (a tapped reply button, also sent to acknowledged). Empty means all.

delete.summary: Delete an outgoing webhook and its delivery log

get.summary: The last 100 deliveries of an outgoing webhook, newest first
get.description: Scope admin. status is pending (next_at is the next try), ok or failed (gave up after 8 tries).

get.summary: List the webhook templates saved for a topic, and the built-in names
get.description: Scope publish on the topic. Secrets are never returned; has_secret says whether one is set.

put.summary: Save a webhook template for a topic, used by POST /{topic}?template=<name>
put.description: Scope publish on the topic. Replaces the whole template. Saving under a built-in name sets its secret and overrides only the fields given.

schema.description: Each field but each and secret is a Go text/template run over the sender's JSON. range, template calls, define and printf are refused. See docs/integrations/custom-webhooks.md.

each.description: Dotted path to a list in the JSON: one notification per item.

priority.description: Renders to 1-5 or min, low, default, high, urgent.

tags.description: Renders to a comma separated list.

id.description: Renders to the external_id: the same id updates one notification.

resolve.description: Renders to "true" to resolve the notification with that id.

secret.description: Write only. Checked as the service's signature (github, jira, sentry, stripe) or as X-Clrd-Secret / ?secret= for the rest.

post.summary: Start a browser sign-in by QR code
post.description: Must be same-origin, no token. Returns a short-lived code (2 minutes, single use), the link a phone opens and that link as a QR code PNG, and sets the clrd_pair cookie that only this browser holds. 429 when too many sign-ins are waiting.

Same-origin, with the clrd_pair cookie from the same browser. Body {"code"}. 202 while waiting; 200 once approved, with the clrd_session cookie set (a token with the approver's access, revoked with it); 410 when denied, expired, used or claimed from another browser.

410.description: Denied, expired or not this browser's

get.summary: Who is asking to sign in
get.description: Any token. The browser name and when it asked, so the approving device can show them.

post.description: The waiting browser is signed in with this token's access. A form post (from /pair) gets an HTML page back.
The waiting browser is told no.

post.summary: Start linking a phone by QR code
post.description: Any token or signed-in browser. Returns a short-lived code (2 minutes, single use), the link <base>/link?c=<code> and that link as a QR code PNG. The clrd app scans it and claims the code; this token then approves the phone by name. 429 when too many codes are waiting.

No auth; called by the clrd app. Body {"code", "secret", "name"}: secret is 32+ characters the app made, name the device name. The first claim binds the secret and name; later claims must send the same secret. 202 {"state":"waiting"} until approved; 200 {"state":"approved", "token", "name"} once approved, with a new token that has the approving token's access and is revoked with it; 410 when denied, expired, used, unknown or the secret does not match.

410.description: Denied, expired, used or another secret

get.summary: Which phone scanned a link code
get.description: Only the token that made the code. name is the phone's name, empty until one scans; state is waiting or claimed.

404.description: Expired, used, unknown or not made by this token

post.description: Only the token that made the code. The phone's next claim gets its token.

404.description: Expired, used, unknown or not made by this token

409.description: No phone has scanned the code yet

post.description: Only the token that made the code. The code is dropped and the phone's next claim gets 410.

404.description: Expired, used, unknown or not made by this token

get.summary: Page a phone link QR code opens
get.description: HTML, for a phone camera that scanned the code outside the app. Query c is the code. A clrd://link?server=...&code=... link that hands the code to the app, or a note that it expired.

get.summary: Approve page the QR code opens
get.description: HTML. Query c is the code. Signed in: Approve and Deny buttons. Signed out: a clrd://pair?server=...&code=... link that hands the code to the app.

basic.description: ntfy style: the token as password (or user).

tag.description: Empty: every notification in the topic

Action.description: A link (url) or an answer button (reply), exactly one of the two. At most 3 reply actions; reply values are 1 to 64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - and unique.

format.description: How clients show message: markdown (default) or plain text. Events from before this field existed have none: treat as markdown.

icon.description: http(s) image URL; the topic's icon when the sender gave none. Empty if unset. Events logged before a server upgrade may omit it: treat missing as empty.

attachment.description: At most one file. Events logged before a server upgrade may omit it: treat missing as null.

reply.description: The reply action tapped, empty until someone answers

expires_at.description: When the server resolves it on its own; null for never.

silenced.description: A silence matched when this was written: show it, do not alert. Events logged before a server upgrade may omit it: treat missing as false.

repeat.description: Re-alert until someone acts, or null. next is null once it stopped.

markdown.description: ntfy-style switch: false means format text. format wins if both are given.

icon.description: http(s) image URL, at most 2048 characters, or empty for none.

attachment.description: External attachment: url is an http(s) URL of at most 2048 characters, name defaults to its last path segment. To upload a file, use multipart/form-data instead.

expires.description: Auto-clear: a duration from now (30m, 2h) or an RFC3339 time. When it passes the server resolves the notification. Must be in the future.

repeat.description: Re-alert every this long (1m to 24h, like 5m) while the notification stays active. Acknowledge, snooze, dismiss or resolve stops it.

repeat_times.description: How many re-alerts at most. Default 10 when repeat is set.

reopen.description: If the notification under this external_id is acknowledged, put it back to active in the same write, so a new question does not inherit the old answer.

via.description: On a state event: how the change was made (app, tray_button, web, mcp, api, ...). See docs/SPEC.md section 5.

epoch.description: On ready only. This database's id. A different one from the saved one means: treat it like reset.

grants.description: Per-topic rules, first match decides (spec section 4). Set by clrd import ntfy or POST /api/v1/tokens. A topic no grant matches is denied.

topic.description: Topic name or pattern with *; matched ignoring case.

attachment.description: url is absolute. Uploaded files need a clrd token to download.

content_type.description: Present when the notification's format is markdown; absent for plain text.

markdown.description: false publishes plain text. Default true (clrd renders Markdown unless told otherwise).

icon.description: Kept when an http(s) URL, else dropped.

attach.description: External attachment URL; a bad one is dropped

Attachment.description: Uploaded: url is /api/v1/files/<id>, fetched with API credentials; type is sniffed by the server. External: an absolute http(s) URL the server never fetches; type is empty and size 0.

Settings.description: Display settings every device follows. One set per server.

keep_cleared_days.description: Days dismissed and resolved notifications are kept after they were cleared; 0 keeps them forever. Until set, follows CLRD_RETENTION (30 days).

sound.description: The asking device's own notification sound (one per device, not per server), a name from GET /api/v1/sounds. default until set.

render_formatting.description: Render Markdown in messages. Default true.

autolink.description: Turn bare URLs into links. Default true.

favicons.description: Show a site icon next to links. Default true.

link_previews.description: Show a preview card for links. Default false.

topic_previews.description: Per-topic override of link_previews. A token limited to some topics only sees its own.

image.description: data: URL of the og:image (raster only, at most 512 KB), so the viewer never contacts the site.

NtfyFilterId.name: id
NtfyFilterId.description: Only the message with this ntfy id. Also read from the X-Id or Id header.

NtfyFilterMessage.name: message
NtfyFilterMessage.description: Only messages with exactly this body (alias m). Also read from the X-Message or Message header.

NtfyFilterTitle.name: title
NtfyFilterTitle.description: Only messages with exactly this title (alias t). Also read from the X-Title or Title header.

NtfyFilterPriority.name: priority
NtfyFilterPriority.description: Comma list of priorities (1-5 or min, low, default, high, max); a message matches any of them (aliases prio, p). Also read from the X-Priority or Priority header.

NtfyFilterTags.name: tags
NtfyFilterTags.description: Comma list of tags; a message must have all of them (aliases tag, ta). Also read from the X-Tags or Tags header.
